new_today.title: Biosemantic graph transfer learning for cross-patient cell type annotation and cell–cell interaction analysis in tumor single-cell RNA sequencing
new_today.title_zh: 用于肿瘤单细胞RNA测序中跨患者细胞类型注释和细胞—细胞相互作用分析的生物语义图迁移学习
new_today.summary_zh: 摘要 通过单细胞RNA测序（scRNA-seq）探索肿瘤微环境（TME）内的细胞异质性，对于理解癌症进展和治疗反应至关重要。然而，当前scRNA-seq方法缺乏空间背景，并依赖不完整的配体—受体相互作用数据集，限制了准确的细胞类型注释和细胞—细胞通讯推断。本研究使用一种新型图神经网络模型应对这些挑战，增强细胞类型预测和细胞相互作用分析。我们的研究使用了来自19名患者、三种癌症类型（白血病、乳腺浸润性癌和结直肠癌）的49 024个细胞组成的数据集。所提出的scGSL模型表现出稳健性能，在所有数据集上平均准确率为84.83%，精确率为86.23%，召回率为81.51%，F1分数为80.92%。这些指标相较现有方法有显著提升，后者通常表现出较低的性能指标。此外，通过回顾现有关于TME内基因相互作用的文献，scGSL模型被证明能以无监督方式稳健识别具有生物学意义的基因相互作用，并通过多种癌症中关键

extra.description: Abstract The exploration of cellular heterogeneity within the tumor microenvironment (TME) via single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) is essential for understanding cancer progression and response to therapy. Current scRNA-seq approaches, however, lack spatial context and rely on incomplete datasets of ligand–receptor interactions, limiting accurate cell type annotation and cell–cell communication inference. This study addresses these challenges using a novel graph neural network model that enhances cell-type prediction and cell-interaction analysis. Our study utilized a dataset consisting of 49 024 cells from 19 patients across three cancer types: leukemia, breast invasive carcinoma, and colorectal cancer. The proposed scGSL model demonstrated robust performance, achieving an average accuracy of 84.83%, precision of 86.23%, recall of 81.51%, and an F1 score of 80.92% across all datasets. These metrics represent a significant enhancement over existing methods, which typically exhibit lower performance metrics. Additionally, by reviewing existing literature on gene interactions within the TME, the scGSL model proves to robustly identify biologically meaningful gene interactions in an unsupervised manner, validated by significant expression differences in key gene pairs across various cancers. The source code and data used in this study can be found at https://github.com/LiYuechao1998/scGSL.

new_today.title: GLAlign integrates single-cell multi-omics data via global manifold and local marker gene alignment
new_today.title_zh: GLAlign通过全局流形和局部标记基因比对整合单细胞多组学数据
new_today.summary_zh: 摘要 整合异质单细胞多组学数据集仍然具有挑战性，因为不同模态在 distinct 特征空间中测量，且缺乏细胞水平配对。现有流形比对或特征转换框架常受弱跨模态关联、几何模糊和过度校正影响。在此，我们提出GLAlign（全局流形和局部标记基因比对），这是一个优化框架，联合利用全局流形结构和局部标记基因信息来整合单细胞多组学数据。GLAlign通过由最大均值差异、失真和惩罚项组成的全局目标，以及由独立推断簇之间跨模态标记基因重叠引导的局部对比三元组损失，学习共享潜在空间。我们展示了GLAlign的方法学贡献，即通过生物学信息先验扩展流形比对，以确保几何上合理且生物学上正确的比对，而无需配对细胞或人工细胞类型注释。我们在模拟数据和真实数据集上评估了GLAlign，涵盖PBMC scRNA-seq/scATAC-seq、小鼠脑SNARE-seq、单供者和多批次CITE-seq，以及NCI-N87 s

extra.description: Abstract Integrating heterogeneous single-cell multi-omics datasets remains challenging because different modalities are measured in distinct feature spaces and lack cell level pairing. Existing manifold alignment or feature conversion framework are often affected by weak cross-modality associations, geometric ambiguity, and overcorrection. Here we present GLAlign (Global manifold and Local marker gene Alignment), an optimization framework that jointly leverages global manifold structure and local marker gene information to integrate single-cell multi-omics data. GLAlign learns a shared latent space through a global objective comprising maximum mean discrepancy, distortion, and penalty terms, together with a local contrastive triplet loss guided by cross-modality marker gene overlap between independently inferred clusters. We demonstrate GLAlign’s methodological contribution in extending the manifold alignment by biologically informed prior to ensure geometrically plausible and biologically correct alignments without requiring paired cells or manual cell type annotations. We evaluated GLAlign on simulated data and real datasets spanning PBMC scRNA-seq/scATAC-seq, mouse brain SNARE-seq, single-donor and multi-batch CITE-seq, and NCI-N87 scDNA-seq/scRNA-seq integration. Across the evaluated datasets, GLAlign achieved strong modality mixing and biological conservation, remained stable under moderate cell type imbalance and variations in clustering and marker information, and supported cross-modality label transfer and paired cell recovery. These results demonstrate that biologically structured coupling of global and local alignment provides an interpretable framework for heterogeneous single-cell multi-omics integration. dropped.title_zh: SeekRBP：利用序列-结构整合与强化学习识别受体结合蛋白。
dropped.summary_zh: 受体结合蛋白（RBP）启动病毒感染并决定宿主特异性，是噬菌体工程和治疗的关键靶点。然而，RBP的识别因其极端序列多样性而复杂化，这往往使传统的基于同源比对的方​​法失效。虽然机器学习提供了有前景的替代方案，但此类方法难以应对严重的类别不平衡以及从异质尾部蛋白中选择信息量大的负样本的困难。现有方法往往无法在从这些“困难负样本”中学习与保持泛化能力之间取得平衡。我们提出SeekRBP，一个序列-结构框架，将负采样建模为序贯决策问题。通过采用多臂老虎机策略，SeekRBP基于实时训练反馈动态优先选择信息量大的非RBP序列，并辅以蛋白质语言和结构嵌入的多模态融合。基准测试表明，SeekRBP始终优于静态采样策略。此外，一项针对弧菌噬菌体的案例研究验证了SeekRBP能有效识别RBP以改善宿主预测，凸显其在大规模注释和合成生物学应用中的潜力。SeekRBP的源代码可通过以下地址获取：https://

extra.description: Receptor-binding proteins (RBPs) initiate viral infection and determine host specificity, serving as key targets for phage engineering and therapy. However, the identification of RBPs is complicated by their extreme sequence divergence, which often renders traditional homology-based alignment methods ineffective. While machine learning offers a promising alternative, such approaches struggle with severe class imbalance and the difficulty of selecting informative negative samples from heterogeneous tail proteins. Existing methods often fail to balance learning from these "hard negatives" while maintaining generalization. We present SeekRBP, a sequence-structure framework that models negative sampling as a sequential decision-making problem. By employing a multi-armed bandit strategy, SeekRBP dynamically prioritizes informative non-RBP sequences based on real-time training feedback, complemented by a multimodal fusion of protein language and structural embeddings. Benchmarking demonstrates that SeekRBP consistently outperforms static sampling strategies. Furthermore, a case study on Vibrio phages validates that SeekRBP effectively identifies RBPs to improve host prediction, highlighting its potential for large-scale annotation and synthetic biology applications. The source code of SeekRBP is available via: https://github.com/Saillxl/SeekRBP.

longest_on_board.title: 基于多智能体深度强化学习的SD-IoT控制器部署
longest_on_board.title_zh: 基于多智能体深度强化学习的SD-IoT控制器部署
longest_on_board.summary_zh: 物联网(IoT)中激增的流量, 影响了传感器等设备的数据传输。利用软件定义网络(SDN)技术可以优化网络性能, 提高数据传输质量。然而, 物联网中流量等网络状态的不断变化会影响软件定义网络控制平面的性能。研究软件定义物联网(SD-IoT)中的动态控制器部署问题, 以在流量变化时保证控制平面性能。考虑到物联网节点的能耗以及数据传输的特点, 在部署控制器时, 综合考虑延迟、控制可靠性以及能耗的影响, 并将该问题构建为马尔可夫博弈过程。为了同时兼顾单一控制器性能以及控制平面整体性能, 采用多智能体深度强化学习求解该问题。在部署阶段利用动作掩码屏蔽部分节点, 避免将控制器部署在性能不足或者供能不方便的节点。仿真实验表明, 与基于Louvain社区划分和基于单智能体深度Q网络(DQN)的部署算法相比, 所提算法可以更好地找到高性能的部署方案。

longest_on_board.title: 基于多信息融合的高速收费站拥堵检测算法
longest_on_board.title_zh: 基于多信息融合的高速收费站拥堵检测算法
longest_on_board.summary_zh: 在高速收费站拥堵检测场景中, 遮挡、阴影、景深等因素严重影响检测算法的精度, 基于单信息的拥堵检测算法无法准确反映收费站真实拥堵情况, 对此, 提出一种高速收费站多信息融合拥堵检测算法。首先采用目标检测算法检测目标区域车辆, 利用图像空间特征计算车道占用率; 其次利用Deep SORT目标跟踪算法与滑动平衡机制进行车流量综合估计, 减少因为遮挡和阴影导致的车辆误检、漏检问题; 最后利用基于光流信息熵的车速估计方法, 降低因景深变化导致的拥堵状态检测误差。通过融合3种不同维度信息得到拥堵指数, 拥堵指数聚类为5种拥堵类别以判断真实拥堵状态, 从而实现高速收费站的拥堵检测。实验结果表明, 在高速收费站拥堵数据集上, 采用多信息融合的拥堵检测算法准确率达到90.4%, 能够实现对收费站拥堵状态的准确检测。
